data.title: Two headlines on the screen

memoryNodes.cue: The facts are checked against the calendar.
Jo checks the relationship between choices.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 乔检查选项之间的关系。

data.situation:
Two versions of the article filled the screen. Nora asked Jo to contrast them before choosing a headline. The first called the closure a dramatic change; the second explained that only the main room would close. The difference in tone was pronounced, although the factual difference was subtle. In contrast to the first version, the revised headline kept the evening activities visible. However, it still needed the date. Jo added Monday, then paused over a sentence beginning conversely. The room could shape a discussion, and a discussion could change the room in return. She wrote: “A quiet room can encourage discussion; conversely, discussion can make a quiet room noisy.” Jo: This headline makes the change sound dramatic.
Nora: Contrast it with the revised version.
Jo: The difference in tone is pronounced. However, both still need a date.

readingBlocks.en: Two versions of the article filled the screen. Nora asked Jo to contrast them before choosing a headline. The first called the closure a dramatic change; the second explained that only the main room would close. The difference in tone was pronounced, although the factual difference was subtle. In contrast to the first version, the revised headline kept the evening activities visible. However, it still needed the date. Jo added Monday, then paused over a sentence beginning conversely. The room could shape a discussion, and a discussion could change the room in return. She wrote: “A quiet room can encourage discussion; conversely, discussion can make a quiet room noisy.”
readingBlocks.zh: 屏幕上并排放着文章的两个版本。诺拉让乔先比较，再选标题。第一版称关闭是一场巨大变化，第二版说明只有主厅会关闭。语气差别明显，事实差别却细微。与第一版相比，新标题让仍举行的晚间活动清楚可见。不过，日期仍需补上。乔加上下周一，然后查看以 conversely 开头的一句。房间会影响讨论，讨论也会改变房间的气氛。她写道：“安静的房间有助于展开讨论；反过来，讨论也会让安静的房间变得嘈杂。”
